name: Jon Watte
current_role: Co-founder, Reve (Reve AI, Inc., Palo Alto AI image-generation startup)
profile: Veteran systems/graphics engineer and one of five co-founders of Reve, the Palo Alto AI image company behind Reve Image (with Christian Cantrell, Michael Gharbi, Taesung Park and Mike Speiser). Earlier he ran Be Inc.'s media group, built avatar/networking tech at There.com, was CTO of Forterra Systems, worked on IMVU and Roblox engineering, and co-founded Observe Inc.
interesting_fact: Reve relaunched in Sept 2025 with a code-like 'layout representation' that breaks images into editable components; Reve 2.0 later ranked near the top of the Arena text-to-image leaderboard (June 2026).
deep_cut_fact: At Be Inc. he took over the media group, working on the low-latency, multiprocessing foundations of BeOS; after Be was sold to Palm he helped build avatar, networking and simulation tech for the virtual world There.com, then became CTO of Forterra Systems.
notes: Hurun lists him under 'Telecommunications' but he is the Reve (AI image) co-founder. Low public profile; no personal accounts verified. Only published Reve email is support@reve.com (customer support, not press). One unverified report mentioned Reve sunsetting; June 2026 coverage shows it active - check current status.

name: Troy Demmer
current_role: Co-founder & Chief Product Officer, Gecko Robotics (Pittsburgh)
profile: Co-founder of Gecko Robotics, which builds wall-climbing inspection robots and the Cantilever data/AI platform to monitor power plants, refineries, Navy ships and other critical infrastructure. He leads product across robotics and software; Gecko reached unicorn status in 2024 and works heavily with the US Air Force and Navy.
interesting_fact: Named to Forbes 30 Under 30 (Energy) in 2019; he and CEO Jake Loosararian were roommates at Grove City College, Pennsylvania.
deep_cut_fact: A 2011 Grove City College finance/economics graduate, he worked as a financial analyst at UPMC (and attended Carnegie Mellon) before joining Gecko; he has credited the UPMC job with teaching him many of the skills he needed to build the company.
notes: Highly relevant to an energy podcast: Gecko inspects boilers/power-plant assets and speaks at CERAWeek. Frequent podcast guest (e.g. 5 Year Frontier), so likely receptive to interviews.

name: Ben Maruthappu
current_role: Co-founder & CEO, Cera (UK home-healthcare / healthtech company)
profile: Dr Mahiben 'Ben' Maruthappu MBE (b. 1988) is a London-born doctor who founded Cera in 2016 after struggling to arrange home care for his mother. Cera uses AI to deliver home care at scale (~3m visits a month, ~£500m annualised revenue in 2025) and is valued at $1bn+. Earlier he was senior fellow to NHS England CEO Simon Stevens and co-founded the NHS Innovation Accelerator.
interesting_fact: Named EY UK Entrepreneur of the Year 2024; reported to be the youngest doctor to receive an MBE (2020, for services to health and social care technology).
deep_cut_fact: As a Cambridge undergraduate (Selwyn College, triple first) he became the first undergraduate invited to lecture medical students, and founded the UK Medical Students' Association while at Oxford; he has also written three medical books, including guides to applying to medical school.
notes: UK-based and media-friendly (City AM, podcasts, EY WEOY). No published press email found; site has a Media section in its HQ menu that is JS-rendered - check it manually. Hurun lists the company as $1bn.
